request.text:
Employee ticket:
Something is wrong with my account I think?

Knowledge base:
[1] Account locked after failed sign-ins · Why it happens
## Why it happens
Ten failed sign-ins in 15 minutes lock the account for 30 minutes. A phone or tablet with an old password saved is the most common cause.

[2] Keyboard types the wrong symbols · Fix
## Fix
If @ and " are swapped, the layout is set to US instead of UK. On Windows open **Settings > Time & language > Language & region** and set the keyboard to "United Kingdom". On a Mac open **System Settings > Keyboard > Input Sources** and add "British".

[3] Account locked after failed sign-ins · Fix
## Fix
Wait 30 minutes or unlock it from the self-service portal with MFA. Then update the password on every device that syncs mail.
